run_clip_augmentation: run clip_augmentation to apply spatial sampling, normalization, and optional color jitter to video frames
test_spatial_sampling: test spatial_sampling to perform random or uniform spatial cropping on video frames
refactor_random_short_side_scale_jitter: refactor random_short_side_scale_jitter to scale video frames while preserving aspect ratio
review_horizontal_flip: review horizontal_flip to randomly flip video frames and adjust bounding boxes
summarize_color_jitter: summarize color_jitter to apply random brightness, contrast, and saturation jitter to video frames
